briefdescription.para: Switch the ILI9881C active register page.

detaileddescription.para: Register map (DSI TX core base): 0x0034 = XDSI_DATA_OFFSET — long packet payload FIFO 0x0030 = XDSI_COMMAND_OFFSET — command queue (header triggers TX) 0x002C = XDSI_STATUS_OFFSET — status: bit-7 = RDY_FOR_LONG

Header is written BEFORE the payload: the ILI9881C never sends a BTA acknowledge, so writing payload-then-header (the naive order) leaves WAIT_FOR_DATA stuck at 1 forever after the first long write. Writing the header first, then the payload, lets the core clear WAIT_FOR_DATA itself as soon as the payload arrives.

briefdescription.para: Write a single register on the active ILI9881C page.
Complete ILI9881C + ATtiny MCU panel initialization sequence.

detaileddescription.para: [I2C] MCU Init : Verify MCU, assert both resets, BL off [I2C] Panel Power ON: Deassert LCD reset (BIT0=1) [DSI] CMD MODE : ILI9881C register init (Pages 3->4->1) [DSI] CMD MODE : Page 0, Tear ON, Sleep Out (120ms), Display ON [I2C] Touch Enable : Deassert touch reset (BIT1=1) [I2C] Backlight ON : full brightness

detaileddescription.para: See dsi_txss_display.h for the split rationale vs DsiPath_StartVideo().

briefdescription.para: Activate the DSI TX Subsystem to begin streaming whatever video is currently presented on its AXI4-Stream input (the VPSS scaler's output, once the switch is steered to the DSI path).

detaileddescription.para: Activate the DSI TX Subsystem so it streams whatever video is currently presented on its AXI4-Stream input (the VPSS scaler's output once the AXI4-Stream Switch is steered to the DSI path).

Call this LAST, only once the upstream sensor/CSI/scaler chain has already been rebuilt and started by the caller (see DsiPath_Reinit()) — matches the ZCU102 reference's EnableDSI(), which is likewise called only after CamReset()/EnableCSI()/ SetupCameraSensor()/StartSensor() have all completed.

Call this first, whenever DSI is about to stop being the active output (or right before DsiPath_Reinit(), to prepare for re-entering DSI) — matches the ZCU102 reference's DisableDSI(), which is always called before its InitDSI() reset step.

briefdescription.para: Hardware-reset the DSI TX Subsystem and re-apply its VIDEO mode timing configuration, without starting it.

detaileddescription.para: Hardware-reset the DSI TX Subsystem (XDsiTxSs_Reset()) and re-apply its VIDEO mode timing configuration, without starting it.

Matches the ZCU102 reference's InitDSI(): a bare XDsiTxSs_Activate(DISABLE)/(ENABLE) toggle is not sufficient to recover the core from having starved on a cut-off AXI4- Stream input (proven empirically — that approach was tried and caused a FIFO under-run on the very first switch to DSI). XDsiTxSs_Reset() clears the byte-stream FIFO and protocol engine state at the register level, so the core comes back in the same known-good state it was in right after boot, instead of whatever state a starve event left it in.

Call this every time DSI is about to become (or stop being) the active output, before DsiPath_StartVideo() — never call DsiPath_StartVideo() without a preceding DsiPath_Reinit() once the core has ever been disabled/starved.
